## What changed

Describe the semantic or operational change and why it belongs in AIR.

## Evidence

- [ ] `pnpm release:check` passes
- [ ] AIR schema/parser changes include migration and validation coverage
- [ ] Target changes include generated build or live evidence where applicable
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changes
- [ ] Commits include `Signed-off-by` certification (`git commit -s`)

## Compatibility

Describe effects on accepted AIR versions, generated output, ownership boundaries, target capabilities, and existing verification evidence.
